items.quote: I started as a just an agent.
items.statement: Speaker started as a real estate agent and has held various roles including sales manager and business owner.

items.quote: you start thinking what makes me more happy.
items.statement: At forty-four, speaker reflects on what makes him happy rather than just focusing on money.

items.quote: nothing about sales techniques or any methodology.
items.statement: Many successful salespeople succeed due to their personality, not solely sales techniques.

items.quote: you are more than welcome to stop me anytime.
items.statement: The speaker encourages participants to interrupt with questions or disagreements during the talk.

items.quote: if you are busy, that means that you're more desirable.
items.statement: Being busy with clients can indicate desirability, as it suggests the agent has multiple clients.

items.quote: I will give you the two weeks trial which will include additional online training.
items.statement: Speaker suggests providing a trial offer of Al-Nair with additional online training.

items.quote: clients which are coming from the off plan social media background, they all work with fifteen, twenty other agents.
items.statement: Clients from social media leads often work with multiple agents, which signifies the challenge of sales resistance.

items.quote: Who closed the deal last month? Raise your hand.
items.statement: Speaker acknowledges having a low response rate to questions about closing deals last month.

overview: Sales training presentation focusing on buyer psychology for real estate agents.
